claude_proposed_widenings.name: repeating_area_save_gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Stinking Cloud creates a concentration area whose only ongoing mechanic is a save gate that fires at the start of each creature's turn while inside the area. No existing family encodes a repeating per-turn save trigger: ongoing_effect only supports passive roll-modifiers and on-hit riders; activation only supports one-shot phases. A new family (e.g. 'repeating_area_trigger') is required whose operation is a start-of-turn save gate over an area attachment.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each creature that starts its turn in the Sphere must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition until the end of the current turn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition: poisoned
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition type currently only includes 'prone'. Stinking Cloud's save-failure result is the Poisoned condition. The type must be widened to include 'poisoned' (and likely the full SRD condition set) before any spell that inflicts Poisoned can be encoded.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition until the end of the current turn.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SaveGateRiderResult: compound (apply_condition + restrict_action)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Poisoned condition in this spell carries an embedded action restriction: while Poisoned in this way, the creature cannot take an action or a Bonus Action. SaveGateRiderResult currently supports either apply_condition or none, with no compound result shape. A compound variant (or a secondary effect attached to the condition) is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While Poisoned in this way, the creature can't take an action or a Bonus Action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: obscure_area
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The cloud is Heavily Obscured, which deterministically affects attack roll advantage/disadvantage for any attack into or out of the area. No v4 atom covers 'make this area heavily obscured'. The closest candidate (block_targeting) is narrower. A new effect atom is needed for area-level obscurement.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Duration termination: dispersed_by_named_spell_or_effect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The cloud can be dispersed by a strong wind (e.g. Gust of Wind), which is a secondary termination condition beyond concentration dropping. No current Duration or lifecycle variant captures 'also ends when a named external effect acts on the area'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The cloud lingers in the air for the duration or until a strong wind (such as the one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it.
